The '''Cronese Mandate''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when the Empire divided the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] into three different sectors: the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]], the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] and the Cronese Mandate.

==Description==
[[File:Cronese_Mandate.jpg|thumb|left|235px|The Cronese Mandate and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Cronese Mandate was the most southern sector of the Tion Cluster.<ref name="Xim Week" /> The Mandate contained 464 inhabited worlds as well as many uninhabited systems. It was the most inhabited of the three sectors of the Cluster, as only about 136 worlds were inhabited in the other two combined.<ref name="MtL">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>

Its principal worlds were along the [[Greater Cronese Arc]]. The [[Kismaano Bypass]] and the [[Indrexu Route]] connected it to the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion]], while the [[Lesser Cronese Arc]] connected it to the worlds of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony's]] [[Back Spiral]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

The inhabitants of the sector were known as the [[Cronese]]. They tended to aloofness, mindful of their imperial past and often dismissing their [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] neighbors as unsophisticated peasants. Cronese had always looked to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in a way the rest of the Tion hadn't.

Most of the Mandate's trade was based on its abundance of [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] wealth, mined in the uninhabited systems. These minerals were the source of the sector's prosperity.<ref name="MtL" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Main|Kingdom of Cron}}
The Cronese Mandate was almost the same area as the historical territory of the [[Kingdom of Cron]]. This kingdom was the center of [[Xer VIII]]'s empire and later [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]], [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 years before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

===Modern history===
The Tion Cluster eventually joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], and in the Republic's final years, the Cluster joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In retaliation, the Empire divided it into three sectors.<ref name="Xim Week" /> The Cronese Mandate contained the fourteen worlds of the former Kingdom of Cron,<ref name="MtL" /> including [[Chandaar]], the historic capital and later the Imperial sector capital.<ref name="Xim Week" />

At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[King of Cron|ruler]] of the Mandate was [[Robeir XXIII]], head of the [[House of Cron]], who paid court to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The Cronese had a certain level of independence and a fairly large [[Navy/Legends|defense fleet]], but were overseen by Imperial troops.<ref name="MtL" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the sector and the entire Cluster integrated into [[Zsinj's Empire]]. They stayed under [[Zsinj]]'s control until [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|his death]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], becoming independent sectors again.<ref name="TEA" />
